data.name: Saikrishna
data.gender_notes: Saikrishna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord Saikrishna is a form of Lord Vishnu who is the god of compassion. He is also known as Sai Baba, and is believed to be the protector and savior of his devotees. The name Saikrishna carries the meaning “God of Compassion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Saikrishna usually hope their child will grow to embody god of compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saikrishna represents the divine power of compassion and love. He is believed to be the ultimate protector and savior, and is known for his mercy and forgiveness.
data.etymology: Saikrishna belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saikrishna total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Rama's story, told in the epic Ramayana, has influenced Hindu literature, music, and art for over 2,000 years. The ideals of truthfulness, loyalty, and purity that Rama embodies continue to be celebrated in India and beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: Rama's life story is a symbol of the divine role each person plays in society, and the importance of living a virtuous life. His return to his kingdom after a long exile and successful battle against the demon king Ravana is seen as a metaphor for the human journey towards self-realization and ultimate liberation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Saikrishna is a name revered in Hinduism, symbolizing the embodiment of Vishnu as the preserver of the universe and the giver of wisdom. It signifies purity, knowledge, and strength, invoking the blessings of Lord Krishna for prosperity, happiness, and spiritual growth.
